source.name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 management clauses, with Amd 1:2024 context considerations
source.copyright: Identifiers and original internal labels only. The assessment prompts are GRC Lake proposals, not reproduced normative requirements.

source.source_limit: The public contents preview omits 6.3; NEN's published revision overview confirms it. Public metadata and guidance establish identifiers and context, not a complete normative assessment or mapping approval.

rows.title: Business context
rows.evidence_checks: context register, business dependencies, review dates, and a documented climate relevance decision

rows.title: Stakeholder obligations
rows.evidence_checks: stakeholder register, obligation owners, tracked commitments, and relevant climate-related expectations

rows.title: ISMS boundaries
rows.evidence_checks: approved scope, included locations, system boundaries, interfaces, and exclusion rationale

rows.title: ISMS process inventory
rows.evidence_checks: process owners, dependency map, operating records, and tracked process improvements

rows.title: Executive sponsorship
rows.evidence_checks: leadership decisions, resource commitments, accountable sponsors, and follow-through records

rows.title: Security policy governance
rows.evidence_checks: approved policy version, distribution records, accountable owner, and review history

rows.title: Accountability assignments
rows.evidence_checks: responsibility matrix, delegated authority, role communication, and unresolved ownership gaps

rows.title: ISMS planning decisions
rows.evidence_checks: planning register, selected actions, accountable owners, and effectiveness review criteria

rows.title: Risk assessment method
rows.evidence_checks: risk methodology, scoring rules, acceptance criteria, asset scope, and repeatability checks

rows.title: Risk treatment decisions
rows.evidence_checks: treatment plans, risk-owner decisions, applicability statement, control selections, and residual risks

rows.title: Security objectives tracking
rows.evidence_checks: objective register, measurable targets, assigned resources, due dates, and progress reviews

rows.title: ISMS change planning
rows.evidence_checks: planned system changes, impact review, owners, sequencing, and retained implementation decisions

rows.title: ISMS resource allocation
rows.evidence_checks: resource plan, budget decisions, staffing allocations, and unresolved capacity constraints

rows.title: Role capability evidence
rows.evidence_checks: role requirements, capability assessments, training outcomes, and retained qualification records

rows.title: Workforce policy awareness
rows.evidence_checks: awareness material, participation evidence, knowledge checks, and follow-up actions

rows.title: ISMS communications
rows.evidence_checks: audience matrix, message owners, channels, schedules, and communication records

rows.title: ISMS record inventory
rows.evidence_checks: required document register, record owners, coverage gaps, and evidence retention locations

rows.title: Document publication workflow
rows.evidence_checks: version identifiers, authors, review decisions, approvals, and publication history

rows.title: Document custody controls
rows.evidence_checks: access restrictions, retention rules, change history, availability checks, and disposal records

rows.title: Operational process execution
rows.evidence_checks: operating criteria, execution records, change exceptions, and outsourced-process oversight

rows.title: Repeated risk assessments
rows.evidence_checks: dated reassessments, change triggers, assessed scope, findings, and escalation decisions

rows.title: Treatment implementation evidence
rows.evidence_checks: completed treatment actions, implementation evidence, residual gaps, and responsible owners

rows.title: Security performance analysis
rows.evidence_checks: measurement definitions, source data, calculation checks, reporting cadence, and resulting decisions

rows.title: Internal audit execution
rows.evidence_checks: audit scope, objective criteria, independent assignments, findings, and reporting records

rows.title: Internal audit scheduling
rows.evidence_checks: audit programme, risk-based priorities, schedules, auditor assignments, and completion tracking

rows.title: Executive review cadence
rows.evidence_checks: dated management meetings, attendees, review scope, and recorded deliberations

rows.title: Executive review evidence
rows.evidence_checks: review packs, prior actions, risk updates, performance trends, and stakeholder feedback

rows.title: Executive review decisions
rows.evidence_checks: approved decisions, action owners, deadlines, resource changes, and follow-up tracking

rows.title: ISMS improvement tracking
rows.evidence_checks: improvement backlog, prioritization decisions, implemented changes, and outcome comparisons

rows.title: Corrective-action follow-through
rows.evidence_checks: issue records, cause analysis, corrective actions, repeat-occurrence checks, and closure evidence
